title.narrative: Financial Intermediary Fund (FIF) for the Tropical Forest Forever Facility (TFFF)
Financial Intermediary Fund (FIF) zur Tropical Forest Forever Facility (TFFF)

description.narrative: Der Financial Intermediary Fund (FIF) soll neben der Verwendung zur Deckung der Sekretariatskosten, für das Aufsetzen des zentralen Finanzierungsinstrument Tropical Forest Investment Fund (TFIF) und zur Deckung operationaler Kosten über 2 Jahre verwendet werden.

The Financial Intermediary Fund (FIF) is intended to be used, in addition to covering secretariat costs, for setting up the central financing instrument Tropical Forest Investment Fund (TFIF) and for covering operational costs over a period of 2 years.
